summary: Backend-only testing of Cloud Photo Gallery API. All 16 pytest cases passed (100%). Covered: /api/ + /api/health responses, auth gating (401 on photo endpoints without/with bad bearer), Pydantic validation (422 for malformed signup), Cognito error pass-through (random login -> 401, bad confirm code -> 400), and CORS headers on simple + preflight requests. Could not exercise authenticated flows (no inbox access for Cognito email code, IAM lacks AdminConfirmSignUp) per review_request.

minor.issue: Uses Pydantic v1-style 'regex=' on Query params for sort_by/order. Pydantic v2 prefers 'pattern='. Currently works but may emit deprecation warnings.

CORSMiddleware is added AFTER include_router in server.py. Works in practice because Starlette wraps middleware on first request, but conventional ordering is to add middleware BEFORE mounting routers.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated Pydantic 'regex=' with 'pattern=' in photos_router.list_photos query params.
(Optional) Move app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware,...) above app.include_router(...) calls in server.py for clarity.

Full end-to-end upload/list/delete flow could not be tested because Cognito sign-up requires email code confirmation and the attached IAM lacks AdminConfirmSignUp. Provide either (a) a pre-confirmed test user's credentials, or (b) a temporary Cognito ID token in test_credentials.md so future agents can validate the photo CRUD path against real S3 + DDB.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth gating is correctly enforced via fastapi.security.HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) + explicit 401 raise in get_current_user — verified for every protected route.
JWT validation in cognito_auth.verify_cognito_token covers: header parse, JWKS kid lookup, signature, exp, issuer, and token_use-specific audience/client_id checks — solid.
auth_router maps Cognito ClientError to HTTPException with the Cognito error message — confirmed (random login -> 401 with 'Incorrect username or password.').

photos_router.confirm_upload wraps a broad except Exception while generating thumbnails -> any unexpected error is returned as 500 with the stack message; consider narrowing or sanitising the detail before returning to clients.
In _row_to_photo, item['width'] is read via item.get('width') but DynamoDB returns Decimal — int() conversion is fine; but None check ordering is correct.

thumbnail_url falls back to a presigned S3 GET when CLOUDFRONT_DOMAIN is empty (current state); this means thumbnails are NOT served via CloudFront in the current deployment despite the architecture mentioning it. Consider populating CLOUDFRONT_DOMAIN in backend/.env once the distribution is live.
ALLOWED_MIME excludes HEIC/HEIF which is common for iOS uploads — acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
test_credentials: Not present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No usable Cognito test user available (would require inbox to receive 6-digit code).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are read-only / negative-path only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All negative/unauth paths verified green. To extend coverage to authenticated flows: ask user to (1) confirm a Cognito user via AWS console, then (2) drop email/password into /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Then add tests that POST /api/auth/login -> use IdToken -> hit /api/photos/upload-url -> PUT real bytes to the presigned S3 URL -> POST /api/photos/confirm-upload -> GET /api/photos -> DELETE /api/photos/{id}. The boto3 IAM user attached to backend/.env DOES allow s3 + dynamodb + cognito-idp:InitiateAuth based on these tests succeeding through the API layer.
